FN-4UPE9RR-4
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 479
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Bryan Brinyark
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/30/2025
House Bill 479 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would
increase the annual obligations of: (1) the local Boards of Registrars, by an undetermined
amount, to report to the Secretary of State's Office the number of voters removed from voter
registration lists; and (2) the Secretary of State's Office, by an undetermined amount, to collect
and publish the data reported pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
